discription: A sine wave with a pulsing amplitude controlled by a low-frequency sine oscillator, perfect for creating a gentle, evolving texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseFreq=2; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var pulse = SinOsc.ar(pulseFreq) * 0.5 + 0.5; sig = SinOsc.ar(freq) * amp * env * pulse; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
